verdict.rationale: Numeral's native integrations calculate tax at invoice time, so tax amounts reach the user's invoicing system. It also validates customer VAT IDs live and handles global registration. Nothing shows invoice-level compliance content reaching the invoice or being generated by the product. Missing for 10: seller VAT/registration numbers printed on invoices, required VAT invoice fields, locale-specific invoice rules (language, currency, numbering), native compliant invoice generation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, invoices come out compliant where I sell — required VAT fields, registration numbers, and locale rules flow through to my invoicing system or are generated by the product itself

citations.quote: Each integration handles tax calculation at checkout or invoice time and records completed transactions back to Numeral for filing and nexus monitoring.
Register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions, on time, every time.
